compartments.compartment: The user requested ways to make lessons easier to read and more fun, specifically adding relevant images. The assistant analyzed the current image pipeline, identified that image URLs were collected but never passed to the AI and that the visual references gallery duplicated images. A three‑phase plan was proposed, with Phase A focused on fixing the pipeline, Phase B on readability, and Phase C on fun enhancements.

compartment.title: Implemented Phase A image pipeline fixes

compartments.compartment: The assistant executed Phase A: injected collected image URLs into the lesson generation prompt, added a post‑processor `injectImagesIntoLesson` to distribute images when none are inlined, and deduplicated the Visual References gallery using a Set. All tests, lint, type‑checking, and E2E suites passed and the changes were committed as `origin/main`.

compartment.title: Verified existing lessons lack images and explained fixes

compartments.compartment: A quick DB audit of 20 existing lessons showed zero inline images and no source image URLs, confirming the pipeline bug. The assistant explained that the AI never saw the URLs and that the gallery previously displayed the same images for every source, and reiterated how the new fixes address these issues.

The assistant added a “Key Takeaways” card that extracts the final summary section from lesson markdown and renders it in a highlighted amber card. Callout blocks (Tip, Warning, Definition, Deep Dive, Success) now include a thin horizontal rule for visual separation. Unit tests covering various heading patterns were added, and the full test suite passed. The changes were committed as `origin/main`.
The user asked to commit and push; the assistant confirmed the previous commit had already been pushed and the working tree was clean.

The user declined confetti and approved all remaining fun ideas. The assistant added: • A sticky “On this page” section navigator that appears when a lesson has three or more `##` headings, with highlighted links while scrolling. • An `LessonImage` component that shows a skeleton placeholder while loading and a “Image unavailable” fallback on error, preventing broken‑image flashes. • Captions below each inline image showing the alt text and source domain. • A “Key Terms” card that extracts bolded terms (deduplicated, filtered) and displays them as badge‑style chips after the Sources section. All tests passed and the work was committed as `44791c7`.

The user requested three representative screenshots for the README. The assistant used Playwright to capture landing, explore, and onboarding pages, optimized the images, placed them in a `screenshots/` folder, and updated the README with markdown links to the new images. Changes were committed as `571a387`.

compartment.title: Proposed lesson categories and search features

compartments.compartment: The assistant outlined a design for dynamic lesson categorisation: add nullable `category` and `subcategory` text fields to `curricula`, let the AI suggest them during generation, and expose them via the public API. A search API would filter on title, description, and the user's original learning‑profile topic. The suggestion was presented for user approval.

compartment.title: Implemented dynamic categories, search, and UI updates

compartments.compartment: Following user approval, the assistant: • Added `category` and `subcategory` columns to the `curricula` table and ran the migration. • Extended the AI schema and generation prompt to include these fields. • Modified the generate route to persist the category data. • Updated the public tRPC router with procedures for category‑filtered listing and search. • Enhanced the web and mobile explore pages with filter chips and a server‑side search bar. • Displayed category information on curriculum detail pages with an optional user‑override edit control. • Adjusted E2E fixtures to mock the new procedures. All unit, integration, and E2E tests passed; the changes were committed as `origin/main`.

facts.ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS: * Curricula tables include nullable `category` and `subcategory` text columns for dynamic classification. * Lesson page renders a sticky section navigator when a lesson contains three or more `##` sections. * Lesson page replaces raw `` with a `LessonImage` component that shows a placeholder while loading and a fallback on error. * Inline images on the lesson page display a caption with the alt text and source domain below the image. * Lesson page shows a key terms card extracted from bolded terms in the lesson content. * Public explore endpoint `listPublished` accepts optional `category`, `subcategory`, and `search` query parameters for filtering.
